about: TPC-H benchmark data at scale factor 0.1: generated (not real) sales records of a wholesale parts supplier, with orders placed from 1992-01-01 to 1998-08-02. region has one row per world region and nation one row per country, each nation in one region. part has one row per part (product) for sale, supplier one row per supplier and customer one row per customer; suppliers and customers each belong to a nation. orders has one row per order a customer placed. lineitem has one row per line of an order: one part from one supplier, with its quantity, price, discount, tax, return flag, line status, ship mode and its ship, commit and receipt dates. TPC-H's partsupp table (supply costs and stock levels) isn't included. Money amounts are plain decimal numbers with no currency, and every comment column is random filler text.

columns.p_name: Part name: five lower-case words from a fixed list, mostly colors.
columns.p_brand: Brand of the part, 'Brand#MN', where M is the manufacturer's number.
columns.p_type: Part type: three upper-case words, e.g. 'STANDARD POLISHED BRASS'; first STANDARD, SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE, ECONOMY or PROMO, then ANODIZED, BURNISHED, PLATED, POLISHED or BRUSHED, then TIN, NICKEL, BRASS, STEEL or COPPER.
columns.p_size: Size of the part, a whole number from 1 to 50.
columns.p_container: Container the part is packed in.
columns.p_retailprice: List price for one unit of the part.
columns.s_name: Supplier name: 'Supplier#' and the supplier number padded to 9 digits.
columns.s_phone: Phone number; its first two digits are the nation number plus 10.
columns.c_name: Customer name: 'Customer#' and the customer number padded to 9 digits.
columns.c_phone: Phone number; its first two digits are the nation number plus 10.
columns.c_mktsegment: Market segment the customer belongs to.
columns.o_orderkey: Order number; the numbers have gaps.
columns.o_custkey: Customer who placed the order (customer.c_custkey); a third of the customers have no orders.
columns.o_orderstatus: Order status: 'F' when every line of the order has l_linestatus 'F', 'O' when every line has 'O', 'P' when it's mixed.
columns.o_totalprice: Order total: the sum over the order's lines of l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax).
columns.o_clerk: Clerk who took the order: 'Clerk#' and the clerk number padded to 9 digits.
columns.o_ordermonth: Year and month of o_orderdate as one number YYYYMM, e.g. 199503 for March 1995.
columns.l_suppkey: Supplier of the part on the line (supplier.s_suppkey).
columns.l_linenumber: Line number within its order, 1 to 7.
columns.l_quantity: Number of units on the line, 1 to 50.
columns.l_extendedprice: Line price before discount and tax: l_quantity times the part's p_retailprice.
columns.l_discount: Discount as a fraction of the price, 0.00 to 0.10.
columns.l_tax: Tax as a fraction of the price, 0.00 to 0.08.
columns.l_returnflag: Return flag: 'R' (returned) or 'A' (accepted) for lines received by 1995-06-17, 'N' for lines received after.
columns.l_linestatus: Line status: 'F' (filled) for lines shipped by 1995-06-17, 'O' (open) for lines shipped after.
columns.l_commitdate: Day the line was promised (committed) for.
columns.l_receiptdate: Day the customer received the line.
columns.l_shipinstruct: Shipping instruction; 'NONE' is a real value meaning no special instruction.
columns.l_shipmonth: Year and month of l_shipdate as one number YYYYMM, e.g. 199503 for March 1995.
columns.l_commitmonth: Year and month of l_commitdate as one number YYYYMM, e.g. 199503 for March 1995.
columns.l_receiptmonth: Year and month of l_receiptdate as one number YYYYMM, e.g. 199503 for March 1995.

glossary.meaning: A year, quarter or month in a question (for example "in 1995") means the order date by default; the ship date and the receipt date are the other readings.
